notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 12, Part 2, v0.3.3
notes.content:
This small update addresses a few outstanding bugs and includes a minor enhancement:

[b]League Editor[/b]: Fixed an issue where you were unable to add additional years to a player's contract.

[b]Coach Promotion[/b]: Resolved a problem where a coach's new position wasn't correctly reflected in their contract after being promoted to a different role.

[b]Personnel Packages[/b]: Corrected a flaw where the AI would include two duplicate offensive linemen in the "Field Goal Kick" formation on the Personnel Packages screen.

Additionally, a small enhancement has been made to the contract negotiation dialogue for both players and coaches. There are now many more varied message options, so the dialogue will feel less repetitive.

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 12, v0.3.2
notes.content:
A small update to resolve an issue reported by the community several days ago.

When starting up a new career, under certain conditions if you abandoned the game early, it would inadvertently delete your saved games.

We look forward to releasing a larger update soon - but needed to get this critical hotfix out there.

notes.title: Oct 2024 Update - v0.3.1
notes.content:
[h1]v0.3.1 IS AVAILABLE NOW[/h1]

We’re excited to bring you a fresh update for Football Legend!

[h2]New Team Logos[/h2]
We’ve replaced the old, generic team logos with all-new, more dynamic designs that are sure to stand out!

Check out some of the new team logos:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/6cf467018b1c19776caf4d8d21fce9bab3d94eb0.gif[/img]

As always, feel free to use the League Editor to upload your own custom logos and team names.

[h2]UI Improvements[/h2]

- Game simulation now shows results immediately as each game finishes, so you can track the outcomes in real time instead of waiting for a "loading" message.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/d3e64e605090c8a123997ebe89463c6ef4d5965d.gif[/img]

- When simulating multiple weeks, we’ve added a new button that lets you pause at the end of each week for greater control.

- You can now add coaches to shortlists, making it easy to track future staff additions.

- Draft prospects can now be quickly added to shortlists in one click.

- Player personality ratings are now visible directly on their profile screens, giving you better insight into your roster.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

- Fixed a math error where simulating multiple games resulted in one extra week being simulated than intended.

- Resolved an issue with the Shortlist screen not loading properly when accessed via keyboard shortcuts.

- On the Shortlist screen, draft prospects and retired players will now be notated as such, instead of having a blank value for their team.

- Fixed a minor display error on the Game Schedule screen where bye weeks appeared as home games. They will now show as neither Home or Away.

notes.title: Sept 2024 Update - v0.3.0
notes.content:
[h1]v0.3.0 IS AVAILABLE NOW[/h1]

Hello football fans,

On this football Sunday, we proudly announce the release of Football Legend version 0.3.0.  This long-awaited update is loaded with new features, bug fixes, game engine updates, and UI improvements.  

Let's get straight into the X's and O's:

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[h3]Shortlists[/h3]
Now you can easily keep track of players by using shortlists!  Keep a list of trade targets, a list of your favorite prospects in the upcoming draft, or former players that you want to keep an eye on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/acd5e59f54be1ea6b452ed87cbefc0120dc31388.gif[/img]

[h3]Quick Detail Popups[/h3]
Access information faster than ever before with the addition of informational popups.  Anywhere you see a player's name, you can right-click on it to display their details in a quick popup window.  On roster breakdowns, you can right-click on a position to display a list of which players you have at that position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/54bd3b87ac91640295833d35de29110b5fa880e2.gif[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed a bug that caused successful coaches to be fired without just cause.

- Fixed an issue where several field goal kicking stats were not displayed accurately in stat tables. The affected fields were for range stats, for example, field goal kicking from 40+ yds.

- Fixed an issue on the Trade screen where your team's cap space was not being updated accurately after completing  a trade.  Also, placed a limit on how many players and draft picks can be included in one trade.

- Fixed an issue in the AI trade offer logic, where in certain conditions a team would end up trading for the same player twice in one trade. This would result in the player appearing on the roster twice.

- Fixed bugs in how stats were being stored for players and coaches that were inducted into the Hall of Fame. This was sometimes causing issues displaying their career stats.

- Fixed issues displaying how many years of experience a player has.

[h2]Game Engine Updates[/h2]
- There was a significant update to player salary amounts.  The salaries that players earn is now much closer to real-life professional salaries.  Previously, backups were making far too much, and good players were not making enough.  Contract structures have been reworked from the ground up, and have been modeled to reflect modern professional leagues.

- The league salary cap was increased to reflect 2024 professional leagues.

- Rival teams now manage their rosters with more intelligence.  As they draft players, sign free agents, build trades, and release players. they now account for additional factors in their current roster and will forecast their future team needs. This results in more competitive AI teams.

[h2]UI Improvements[/h2]
- The UI for starting a new game has been fully re-done, and includes more instructional text to help get your new coaching career started.

- Many screens have been updated to use improved data tables. The improvements allow for sorting by any column, tooltips on column headers, alternating rows of color for easier scanning, and consistent cell spacing.

- Tables of data will now display a fallback message when there is nothing to show, instead of displaying just an empty table.

- Added a new table for displaying a player's career contract history.

- On the playoffs screen, added a label to display which conference is which on the playoff tree.

- Reworked to main season screen to reduce clutter and improve the look and feel of the game display.

- A lot of small UI tweaks in other places...but we've covered some of the highlights.

Thank you for your continued support!  We hope to release another update soon with even more improvements and new features!

notes.title: Update Notes - April 4th
notes.content:
A small hotfix to a couple of issues reported by the community:

- Enhanced the logic for determining if a team offers you a contract extension or not. Teams are now far more likely to reward you with an extension if you perform well.

- Fixed issues on the "Action Required" modal, where the modal would sometimes be empty, and not allow you to see the notification.

notes.title: The League Editor Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Football Legends!

We are thrilled to announce the latest update for Football Legend, packed with exciting new features, enhancements, and bug fixes! In this release, we introduce the highly anticipated League Editor, empowering you to easily create custom leagues. Model real-world pro leagues or come up with something new all on your own. Alongside this game-changing addition, we've polished various aspects of the game, from UI enhancements to bug fixes, to ensure a smoother and more immersive gameplay experience. 

Let's dive into the details of what this update brings to the gridiron!

[h3]The League Editor[/h3]
Introducing the League Editor, accessible through the "Settings" menu, allowing you to create custom leagues effortlessly.
[list]
[*] Customize league name, abbreviation, championship game, and logo.
[*] Tailor conference names, abbreviations, and logos to your preference.
[*] Define division names and abbreviations for a personalized experience.
[*] Design team locations, names, abbreviations, colors, and logos for a unique touch.
[*] Customize player details, personalities, ratings, contracts, and profile images to shape your league's talent pool.
[*] Define coach names, details, personalities, ratings, coaching preferences, contracts, and images to guide your teams to victory.
[*] Export your custom league as a mod that you can use for new careers, or share it with the community.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=Mhe_WdUL1aE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Additional New Features[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added a "Coach Legends" screen showcasing historically successful coaches, accessible from the "History Book" screen. How does your career stack up against the other great coaching legends?
[*] Introduced a "Player Ratings Explorer" screen for quick access to player ratings on your team. Quickly find out who your slot receiver should be, or who the best long-snapper on the team is.
[*] Added support for putting the game into "windowed mode", accessible from the Game Settings page.  Now you can easily switch between full-screen mode and windowed mode.
[*] Integrated player images, coach images, conference logos, and league logos into the UI of several existing screens.
[*] Revamped the user interface across multiple screens to enhance functionality, aesthetics, and consistency.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues on the Playoffs screen and Game Log screen related to incorrect display and labeling.
[*] Addressed inconsistencies in the header bar when viewing other teams around the league. Setting colors and logos was sometimes done incorrectly.
[*] Corrected display errors on the Schedule screen regarding playoff dates.
[*] Resolved issues with Draft screen functionality and Free Agency period completion.
[*] Fixed an issue sometimes preventing offering contract extensions to coaches on your staff.
[*] Rectified inaccuracies on the League Team Stats screen regarding Turnover Differential.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback as we strive to make Football Legend the greatest football simulator around. We hope you enjoy these new features and improvements!

[i]Keep your eyes peeled for an upcoming update where we'll unveil an exciting roadmap, mapping out the next major milestones planned for Football Legend. Get ready to embark on this journey with us as we continue to push the boundaries of football management simulation.[/i]

notes.title: Update 5.1
notes.content:
This small patch works on resolving an issue introduced in Update 5.  

Some users reported that they had trouble accessing any of the screens that got the new "Change Team Dropdown" that was introduced.  This update works to fix the issue, and/or provide the developers with additional information in the game logs.

notes.title: Update 5
notes.content:
Hello football fans,

We are thrilled to release our 5th update to Football Legend, packed with brand new features and numerous bug fixes. We have tailored the update based on your invaluable feedback, and cannot wait to get it into your hands.

Here are details on what is included in Update 5:

[h2]Explore With Ease: The Change Team Dropdown[/h2]
Introducing an enhanced navigation system across multiple screens! Say hello to our new team selection dropdown, conveniently situated in the header bar. Seamlessly maneuver through various teams using a traditional dropdown menu, arrow buttons, or built-in keyboard shortcuts. Dive deep into team rosters, coaching staffs, stats, and scout potential trade targets effortlessly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/f377c68a5511800a5313fe6b14397d71c33f5c9f.gif[/img]

This new dropdown feature is available on:

[list]
[*] Roster screen
[*] Staff screen
[*] Contracts screen
[*] Game Schedule screen
[*] Team Season Stats screen
[*] Team Career Stats screen
[*] Team Overview screen
[/list]

[h2]AI Roster Management Tweaks[/h2]
The AI has been updated in regards to how tactfully they will work to improve their roster. When AI teams are constructing trade offers, they will now better address their team's weaknesses and craft more impactful trade offers.

The AI has also been improved in regards to cutting players from their roster. AI teams now make smarter decisions on who they are cutting, and will work to keep dead weight off of their roster. 

[h2]Trade History Screen[/h2]
Unveiling a brand-new screen! Delve into the intricate details of every league trade spanning the last three years. Accessible through the "League" menu, explore your league's comprehensive trade history at your fingertips.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/9384821c4ee74ea8a2ea97f2a25e5522bd08c5de.gif[/img]

[h2]Player Details[/h2]
Now, when you view the Player Details screen, the header bar showcases information about that player's team, enhancing your immersive experience. Previously, the header bar would always show details about the user's team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/3ec4431b9ece9579c96d0694a36cfe7feed029d6.gif[/img]

Let us know what you think of the new update!  Stay tuned for more exciting enhancements coming your way soon!

Join us as we continue to elevate your Football Legend experience!

notes.title: Update 4.2
notes.content: Fixed an issue on Playoffs screen causing the "Game Log" button to not be displayed correctly.

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
- Added a quality-of-life improvement, to help reduce "clickiness".  When a table of players lets you filter by a specific position, the game will now remember your selection. For example, if you are looking at the list of Free Agents and you filter the list by WR, when you come back to this screen later the list will automatically be set to WR. Each screen remembers it's own value - it is not a single shared global value. At the end of each season, the remembered values are reset. The following screens will now remember the last selected position: 
  -- the Draft screen
  -- the Free Agency screen
  -- the Scouting Combine screen
  -- the Available Free Agents screen
  -- the Draft Prospects screen

- Fixed a bug on the tooltip for player injury icons. Dates were being calculated incorrectly, causing the tooltip to say the injury would be over in a negative number of days. This was confusing and misleading. This issue is fixed, and the tooltip will now correctly reflect when the player will be ready to return.
  -- Additionally on the player injury icon, more information was added to the tooltip. The tooltip now displays the body part where the injury occurred, the severity of the injury, how many weeks until the player is ready to return, and how many weeks it has been since the injury happened.

- Fixed an issue on the "Finish Season" screen, on the "Retiring Players" panel, where every player was showing as a Free Agent, instead of it showing the team that they most recently played for.

- Fixed an issue on the "Finish Season" screen on the "Retiring Coaches" panel, where using the "Show Only Your Team" button was not correctly showing only coaches from your team.

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
- Several users reported seeing "Action Required" modals pop up, and be either blank, or with erroneous information on them. Made some changes to work on preventing this.
- On the Main Menu, prevent the "Continue Game" button from showing when there is no previous save game file to load.
- When starting a new save, added slightly-improved UI handling. After typing in a save game name, you don't have to "click away" for the "Start New Game" button to activate anymore.  It will also prevent you from using a save game name that already exists.
- When picking a team at start of career, clicking team logos was causing issues. Prevented the clicks from doing anything.

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content: - Working on resolving the crashing/hanging issue some players are having when starting a new save game. Made changes to address the cause of the crash. Added more logging for additional research and/or confirmation on the issue.

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
- Working on resolving issues on the "Start New Game" screen. Some players have reported getting stuck in a bad state when starting a new game. Causing the save game file to not be created successfully.

- Adjusted the AI's draft logic so that certain positions are valued differently in the early stages of the draft. This will help add more realism to the results of drafts.

notes.title: Football Legend - Dev Update - October 2023
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the upcoming release of our highly-anticipated football management simulator game, Football Legend.  We are set to hit Steam next month, November 2023!

Get ready to step into the shoes of a pro football manager and take control of your dream team on the path to glory.

[h2]What Is Football Legend?[/h2]

Football Legend is THE football management simulator you've been waiting for. It offers an immersive and realistic football management experience, combining strategy, tactics, and the thrill of competing to dominate the league. You'll have the power to shape your team, make crucial decisions, and lead them to victory on the gridiron.

[h2]What Have We Been Working On?[/h2]

Soon after our last dev update, we initiated a closed beta test, and we're excited to report that it was an overwhelming success. Thanks to the invaluable feedback from our beloved testers, we made significant strides in our game's development. We tackled numerous bugs, fine-tuned the functionality of various screens, introduced additional "help" features and tooltips, and achieved substantial improvements in overall game stability.

In addition to addressing feedback from the beta test, we were hard at work crafting features we are extremely proud of. Here are some details:

[h2]Overtime Customization[/h2]
When a game is tied at the end of the 4th quarter, games will now go into overtime. There is nothing more exciting than an overtime nail-biter, and we are happy to announce full overtime support.  Now, you have the power to decide how overtime works in your league. You can choose to have no overtime at all and call it a tie. You can implement sudden-death overtime, or ensure each team gets an opportunity at possession. Not only that, you can set the duration of overtime to 5, 10, or 15 minutes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/bcac3aa70e32c35f6779295f3d3994bd41c4de05.png[/img]

[h2]Import Custom Leagues[/h2]
We are extremely excited about this one!  We're unlocking limitless potential for your football universe. You now have the ability to import entirely custom leagues. Import custom teams, players, coaches, divisions, and conferences. Upload custom team logos and player images. Create a football world of your own making, modeling it after real-life leagues or letting your imagination run wild in a fantasy universe.

[h2]Export Custom Leagues[/h2]
The flip side of being able to import custom leagues, is being to export them. This innovative feature allows you to take a snapshot of your league at any given point in time, and export it in a format that can be used as a custom league.  Share your league online with others to use or create branching parallel universes, and watch as your football universe unfolds in unique ways.

Your league is exported as simple CSV files, allowing you to edit the files in a spreadsheet application or text editor. This makes it easy for mod-pack designers to edit custom leagues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/7278561ed13a09ebaecc7e574c70387467cf2cec.png[/img]

[h2]Enhanced Running Game Control[/h2]
Take charge of your running game like never before. You can now set a third-down back to optimize your chances of converting those critical third and long situations. Get your best receiving back in there and get that conversion. 

On the flip side, when facing critical short-yardage situations, you can now set a short-yardage, power back. Send your biggest and baddest runner straight up the middle to gain those valuable yards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/723038a02d67817c4b4836905526a7816ce7a4d8.png[/img]

[h2]Hotkeys for Effortless Navigation[/h2]
This is a text-based sports simulator.  It's "glorified spreadsheets".  Being able to quickly hop around from screen to screen is critical for this type of game. We're excited to introduce a brand-new feature: hotkeys. 

Easily navigate to any screen, whether it's your team's roster, the league standings, or the depth chart, with just a few simple keyboard shortcuts. It's all about making your management experience smoother and more efficient.

[h1]Coming Next Month! November 2023![/h1]
The pro football season is in full-swing.  We simply cannot wait for Football Legend's release, so that you can get your season underway too!

Stay tuned for an announcement on an exact release date.  We are in the final stages of getting all of our ducks in a row with Steam, and will let everyone know when we have a hard-set date.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Football Legend - Dev Update - August 2023
notes.content:
Hello fellow gamers and football fans!  Welcome to the August 2023 developer update blog.  This past month we have been laser focused on adding in new features and fixing up bugs.

We are in the beginning stages of setting up a closed beta-test. If you are interested in being a beta-tester, please reach out to us. We only have a limited number of slots left.

Without further ado, here are some of the features and changes that have been made this month. If you have any questions or feedback, do not hesitate to reach out! I would love to hear from you.

[h3]Dead Cap Space[/h3]
Last month we unveiled the addition of dead cap space, which is when you have to pay a player the remainder of the money they were guaranteed, even though they are no longer on your team.

We have continued building out dead cap space by adding a new screen which displays all of the dead cap space that is on your books. Get total visibility into your dead cap situation by seeing who you owe, how much you owe, and when you owe it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/36d2317bb3670d4fc436cbe9ba0eed1c7f15b036.png[/img]

Dead cap space is now also being applied during trades. When trading a player away to another team, any dead cap space from that player's contract will be applied to the team's books.

[h3]Draft Ledger[/h3]
The Draft Ledger will show you the draft order for the next three years of upcoming drafts.  We re-did this screen to provide additional information, and to make the information easier to scan through.

You can now get a quick bird's eye view of your upcoming drafts.  See exactly how many picks you have in each round. See the draft order of the entire league. See which teams are stocking up on picks for the next draft.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/a4f1096f4da541d1f2ac6b0851eff6b298e97307.png[/img]

[h3]Improved Game Log[/h3]
The Game Log shows you each and every play that happened during a game.  We re-did how this system works so that the game logs are easier to read through and follow.

Get a play-by-play account of all the on-field action.  See the down, yards remaining, field position, the score, game clock, and more.  Important plays are color-coded to assist in scanning through a log for important events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/280455fce241ab43ad276da2ec18a759d8636c75.png[/img]

[h3]Penalties[/h3]
As much fun as it is to hate on referees, they are essential to the game of football. Their job is to enforce the rules of football, and call penalties when a team breaks a rule.

Games now have penalties called, just as in real-life.  All of the real-world penalties are here - offsides, defensive and offensive pass interference, roughing the passer/kicker, holding, etc.  Penalties can be accepted or declined.

The amount of penalties that your team commits is based on several factors.  The ratings of players and coaches are factored in to how many penalties a team might commit.  Coaches and players have a "Discipline" rating, which affects how often your players will commit a penalty.  

If your Defensive Coordinator is not great with instilling discipline, but your Offensive Coordinator is, then you might expect your defense to commit more penalties than your offense does. If you have a loose-cannon type of player, they are more likely to commit penalties.

[h3]Player Injuries[/h3]
Additional work was done to make injuries more realistic. If a player suffers the same injury multiple times, there is a chance the player can become more injury prone, and is more likely to be injured again.  A player that continues down this path will become nearly unplayable, as their bodies are broken down.

If a player suffers a catastrophic injury, there is a chance it will make them more injury prone. There is also a chance a severe injury can reduce the player's future potential.

We added a new table that displays a player's injury history throughout their career.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/dec6aff94d4235a509e38aff8222e471499ab91f.png[/img]

[h3]Team Turnover Stats[/h3]
A new stats table was added to show team turnover stats. Get detailed info on giveaways, takeaways, turnover differential and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/3046580aa40456f8b9b4520c3de7ae7579a7b7ef.png[/img]

[h3]Team Penalty Stats[/h3]
A new table was added that shows team penalty stats. Review how often your team commits penalties, and exactly in which areas they are committing the most.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/fe51b7407fcb5ab07942a1239a2515afef0da26c.png[/img]

[h3]Team Redzone Efficiency Stats[/h3]
A new view was added that details how teams are performing in the red zone, on both offense and defense.  Review how your team is performing in this critical area, and determine what areas need improvement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/2b5d6cb72192d3e1f8fc2d6db7ec80692a2706f8.png[/img]

[h3]Team History[/h3]
A new screen was added that gives a year-by-year breakdown of how a team performed in prior seasons. See win-loss records, awards won, playoff success, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/00b3b27b670ae4c5917fe6f241d7c21e258047b3.png[/img]

[h3]Team Comparison[/h3]
A new view was added that lets you compare team ratings and historical statistics. This information can help you see where team's are currently at, and what kind of success they have had in the past.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/d9bc2d5c7ddb1d4ec2a314dd8bdbfe6908fa64b5.png[/img]

[h3]Team Contract Offers[/h3]
Get a quick view into all of the contract offers you have made throughout a season. See both player contracts and coach contracts, all in one view.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/645d43239560a553806700218cbb86c48fd8e6c5.png[/img]

[h3]Football Engine Updates[/h3]
Here are a variety of updates that were done to the football simulation engine.  We aim to offer the most realistic football simulation around, and are very proud with the current state of it.

[list]
[*] A trade deadline is now being enforced. After the trade deadline has passed, you will not be able to make any trades until later on when the trade window opens back up.
[*] The amount of plays that a coaching staff can have in their playbook is now being impacted by the ratings of the coaching staff. A skilled head coach and a skilled offensive coordinator will be able to have more plays in their playbook than a team with a bad coaching staff.
[*] Optimized how retired players and coaches are stored after their careers are over. This reduced the size of a save game file by around 50%. This helps ensure smooth gameplay as your progress through decades of your coaching career.
[*] Reduced how likely it is for a team to hire a coach that has worked for them within the past few years. With each passing year, this bias fades a little bit more.  For example, a coach is released from a team after his contract expires.  The team is very unlikely to hire that coach again within the next year. In two years, the team may be slightly open to bringing the coach back.
[*] Implementing the concept of a "pancake block".  A blocker can knock a defender off of his feet, effectively removing the defender from taking part in the play.  Also added statistical tracking for this stat.
[*] Added statistical tracking for "passes defended". This is when a defender makes a play that results in a pass falling incomplete.
[*] Added a new statistic for "QB Rating". This follows the same formula used by major American football leagues.
[*] Tweaked how often punts go out-of-bounds, and the concept of sometimes the punter will want to kick the ball out of bounds (maybe to pin the other team deep).
[/list]

There was also a plethora of various bug fixes that were put in, but we won't get into that now. This post is long enough already.

[h3]Until Next Time...[/h3]
That's it for now folks!

It's one of the most exciting times of the year. Pro and college football is right around the corner. What a fantastic time of year to be a football fan!  Enjoy the kickoff, and be safe! 

We will catch you next month for our next developer update. Take care!

notes.title: Football Legend - Dev Update - July 2023
notes.content:
Greetings, football aficionados and aspiring managers! We are thrilled to bring you an exciting update for our football management simulator, Football Legend!

[h2]Dead Cap Space[/h2]
We are proud to introduce the highly-anticipated addition of dead cap space, a feature that enhances realism and challenges you to make strategic decisions in managing your team's roster. Prepare to navigate the delicate balance between fielding a winning team and staying under the salary cap.

[u]Financial penalties[/u]
Releasing a player that still has guaranteed money remaining on their contract will result in dead cap space. This means that you will continue to carry a portion of their salary against your team's salary cap, even though they are no longer on your roster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/ac7b4734356d0b1731e5a74a389a1da95863241e.png[/img]

[u]Cap management challenges[/u]
Dead cap space can significantly impact your team's ability to sign new players or extend contracts for existing players. It requires careful planning and consideration to avoid long-term repercussions on your team's financial health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/1d12f4e72a88373956dfb48be8b579b5b587c9ef.png[/img]

[h2]Draft Class Scouting[/h2]
We are thrilled to unveil the enhancements we've made to draft class scouting. We have added all-new Draft Rankings and the ability to view Scouting Combine results. Get ready to start planning next year's draft, and find the next franchise-changing player.

[b]Introducing Enhanced Draft Rankings[/b]
In our relentless pursuit of authenticity and realism, we've completely overhauled the scouting system for draft prospects. It was previously....errr....lacking. The new Draft Rankings screen offers you the ability to review the national rankings for the next draft class.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/21628728d871265866bd822d1e69772d0d7ec9c9.png[/img]

Whether you are looking for the #1 top national prospect or trying to find a serviceable late-round backup QB, you can rely upon the national rankings to help guide your search.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/ec483027f874a34d1f8038f808babc43afa1d961.png[/img]

[h2]Pro-Style Scouting Combine[/h2]
To further enhance the scouting experience, we're introducing pro-style Scouting Combine results into our game. Shortly before each draft, prospects will show off their athletic and mental capabilities through a series of drills and tests. The results of these tests are critical in making an informed decision when selecting players for your team.
[list]
[*] Gain access to key physical measurements and performance metrics that help evaluate the prospects' athletic prowess.
[*] Uncover the raw speed of the prospects and assess their explosiveness and acceleration on the field. 
[*] Evaluate the prospects' upper body strength and endurance, factors that are crucial in many positions on the football field.
[*] Gauge the prospects' leaping ability, a critical attribute for wide receivers, defensive backs, and other positions that require exceptional agility and ball skills.
[*] Evaluate the mental makeup of a player by reviewing their Wonderlic test score, and their psychological exam results. There is more to being a good player than just physical tools, the right mental attributes are needed to succeed.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/d27366347ed53cec53db7b383355596c36f58b0c.png[/img]

[h2]Overhauled Training Camp Results[/h2]
The Training Camp screen has been re-designed to allow for better and faster analysis.  Discover which players have shown the most progress since last year.  Find out which players might be on the hot seat, and have regressed since last year.

Keep tabs on your young studs to ensure they are progressing how they should be. Keep an eye on how your veterans are holding up, and whether it might be time to move on from them.

The old design for this screen simply wasn't good enough, and it was important to improve it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/aa56195d2a548429baff807132010334dcc3e71c.png[/img]

[h2]Other Enhancements[/h2]
A quick overview of some other interesting things we have worked on:
[list]
[*] We adjusted the logic for setting the height and weight of players for the in-game universe. Real-world data was used to tweak the numbers, and we are pleased with the level of realistic results now.  Lineman are huge, and punters are small. The results line up with the real world much better now.
[*] We improved how the football simulation engine was handling physical rating attributes.  The physical traits of a player (strength, speed, acceleration, etc.) now have more impact than ever. A player's physical traits are now just as important as their technical skills.
[*] The logic for selecting players and coaches into the Hall of Fame was adjusted to account for more variables. There were inductees being put into the Hall of Fame that were not deserving, and we needed to plug some gaps in the process.
[*] The logic for assigning ratings to coaches has been overhauled to provide more varied and realistic results.
[*] The simulation engine for pass plays has been overhauled to account for many more variables. The height of receivers and defenders is now factored in. The ability of receivers to adjust to bad throws is now accounted for. Some quarterbacks are better at long throws, some better at short throws, this is now accounted for in a meaningful way. Pass defenders now have multiple factors accounted for when trying for an interception.  Simply put, the depth and realism of the passing game is now more accurate than ever!
[*] There were many other bugs, flubs, blips, and bloops that were resolved. We've been hard at work polishing the game and fixing minor quality-of-life issues.
[/list]

Stay tuned for more exciting updates as we continue to refine and enhance the game, ensuring an immersive and unparalleled football management experience. Take charge of your team's financial destiny, make shrewd decisions, leverage your strengths, and lead your franchise to glory on and off the field!

Until next time, keep scouting, keep analyzing, and keep unearthing the future stars of the game!

Beef
Developer of Football Legend

notes.title: Football Legend - Dev Update - June 2023
notes.content:
Hello, and welcome, to the Football Legend June 2023 Dev Update!  It has been 4 long months since our last post, and I am excited to share everything we've been up to. 

We've been hard at work preparing the game for the upcoming Early Access release. The original goal was to have an Early Access version available by the end of 2023.  I am happy to say that we are still on track for achieving this!

I have been polishing things up, fixing a ton of bugs, and improving the simulation engine. I've been adding in the final few systems that were missing. I've been making the hard decisions on which features are not going to make the initial Early Access release.

I have spent a lot of time playing through the game and figuring out what needs tweaking. It has been a blast play-testing the game I have spent the last couple of years building!  I simply cannot wait for you to get your hands on it soon!

And now...I proudly present to you some of the new features that have been added in the past few months.

[h2]Defensive Gameplan[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/9ae061ab01a2afc6c213aaafd4b817944d841d55.png[/img]

A massive overhaul was made to defensive gameplans. Your defensive gameplan allows you to set up exactly which plays you will run in each different situation you will encounter. If you have a talented linebacker that can rush off the edge, you can control exactly how often you blitz him.  If you are about to face a team with a mobile quarterback, adjust your gameplan to use more QB spy coverages.

Handpick the plays that perfectly align with your team's strengths, personnel, and preferred defensive philosophy. From aggressive blitz packages to conservative coverage schemes, the choice is yours.

Choose from all types of coverages - Cover 2, Cover 3 Cloud, Man To Man, Press 1, and many more. You can double up coverage on your opponent's best receiver, blitz multiple defenders, run buzz coverages to stack the box, and much more.

This all culminates in giving you total precision over how your defense will operate.  But...as always, you can choose to focus on other things, and let your staff build the gameplan for you.

[h2]Defensive Play Diagrams[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/d1575af441c23945fad3f1640dade8d3b96035dc.png[/img]

Announcing the addition of defensive play diagrams. These handy diagrams give you a visual representation of what each player will be doing in each play.  The diagram provides a comprehensive overview of your team's defensive formations, coverage schemes, and player assignments. You can strategize the perfect defensive setup like never before.

[h2]Team Overview[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/b5142ba64ef483d3cf454f7cb2c8d2fe9457edb7.png[/img]

The Team Overview screen has been completed. This birds-eye-view dashboard lets you quickly review the details on a team.  You can scan the team's best players, review the team's schedule, view game logs, track pending free agents, see the injury report, and much more.

[h2]Player Ratings[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/a943e40518e437f3ef9b890de761ae7cb713bbbd.png[/img]

The display of player ratings have been redone, and are now grouped by type (rushing, receiving, blocking, etc...). The rating is given a color based upon how skilled the player is. This makes it much easier to quickly analyze a player's skills. 

[h2]AI Improvements[/h2]

The whole point of this game is to realistically simulate football. There has been a ton of work put in to improving the core football simulation engine. 

[list]
[*] The AI for offering free agents contracts has been vastly improved. The outcome of the offseason free agency period is now much more realistic. Teams now make intelligent and thoughtful decisions on which free agents they approach to sign.
[*] Every play has certain strengths and weaknesses, and improvements were made to the simulation engine for this. You'll be punished for running a Cover-1 defense against an empty Shotgun set on 3rd and long.  You'll be rewarded for stacking eight in the box on 3rd and short.
[*] The complexity of the football simulation engine has been vastly improved. More factors than ever have been incorporated into the simulation. The height of your wide receivers matters. The hangtime of your punts matter. The ability of your running backs to pick up blitzes matters. Some quarterbacks struggle delivering short passes, while thriving on the long ball.
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]

An inefficient and clunky UI is the kiss of death for sports management simulator games. We know this. We put a lot of effort into streamlining how you navigate through the game:

[list]
[*] On the Offseason Workout Report screen, a new section has been added to display the best and worst performers. This lets you quickly see who has made the most progress in the offseason, and who has dropped off fast.
[*] When your coaching staff has a vacancy, a new process has been added to help you navigate through filling the position with the best candidate available.
[*] When reviewing tables of stats, a subtle highlight is now applied to any player on your roster, any time your team is listed, and any time your coach is listed. This helps immediately identify relevant data to you.
[*] Improvements were made to how drilling into player stats works. Analyzing player statistics is now much more streamlined, and takes less "clicks" to get the pertinent information.
[/list]

With these groundbreaking defensive coaching features, and everything else that's been done, we've taken football management simulation to new heights. We are dedicated to building the most realistic and expansive football management simulator ever created.

Stay tuned for more exciting updates as we continue to refine and enhance the game, ensuring an immersive and unparalleled football management experience. Get ready to lead your team to glory, as you rise through the ranks of the football world and become a Football Legend!

Until next time, keep strategizing, keep innovating, and keep dominating!

Beef
Developer of Football Legend

notes.title: Football Legend - Dev Update - Feb 2023
notes.content:
Welcome to the first edition of our Football Legend game development blog! 

In this post, we'll be taking a closer look at some of the new features and improvements we've been working on.  We have been hard at work creating the world's most immersive and realistic football management simulator. This is our first update post since unveiling Football Legend to the world, so hopefully you are as excited as we are!

[h2]Coach contracts[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/eecba54b63a6a98332b6ce281c593ac72d792582.png[/img]

One of the major new features we've added to the game is realistic contracts for coaches. Coaches now have varying contract lengths and salary amounts, just like in real life. When hiring a new coach, you'll need to negotiate the terms of their contract, taking into account their experience, track record, and reputation. You'll also need to consider your team's budget and long-term goals.

If you're looking to hire a top-tier coach, you can expect to pay a premium salary and extend a longer contract. On the other hand, if you're just starting out or trying to rebuild a struggling team, you may need to look for a more affordable coach with a shorter contract. The length of the contract will also affect your team's long-term strategy, as you'll need to plan ahead and make sure you have the resources to retain your coach or find a suitable replacement.

[h2]Re-negotiate contracts with coaches[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/5ef32adc01ad62c9ff137caa340ade4acdacf59e.png[/img]

You can re-negotiate contracts with coaches on your staff. if they are over-performing and you want to reward them with a better deal, do it.  If your best position coach only has one more year left on their deal, lock them into a new multi-year deal.

[h2]Fire coaches[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/7981e03911b79baeb4490c8a99e6551af78e1b0e.png[/img]

We have also added the ability to fire coaches on your staff.  Terminating a contract early will require you to pay out the remainder of their contract, so be careful. Firing a coach can have consequences for team morale and performance, so it's important to weigh the pros and cons of this decision before proceeding.

[h2]Get fired[/h2]
Staff coaches are not the only ones that can get fired, though, so don't get too comfortable! If you are not performing up to the team's expectations, you yourself can be fired.  If this happens, you can apply for other open positions around the league, or wait until a team offers you a position that you like.

[h2]Fill vacant coaching position[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/403eecdc76cad4ed9c1dc0e9339627ff1fed1d68.png[/img]

When there are vacancies on your coaching staff, you can now review all of the available coaches out there, and find the perfect replacement. Make sure you hire the right coach for the position. A special teams coach will naturally not be the best quarterbacks coach, so make sure you find the right fit. Having coaches in a position not suited to their skills can be disastrous for your team development and chemistry.  On the contrary, finding the right coach for the right position can maximize your teams potential.

[h2]Coach Profile[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362445/86a0b17ffbe077d3bbce7db311b8bf08dd56c530.png[/img]

We have added a coach profile screen, where you can review everything about a coach. This includes their ratings, personal info, career stats, and career history.  One of our main goals with this game is being able to provide you with all of the stats and history you need to really get invested in the players and coaches inside the game universe. The coach profile screen gives your full-access into seeing how a coach's career has gone.

[h2]Other updates (non-coaching related)[/h2]
While we've been focusing on expanding our coach mechanics, we have put in a few other noteworthy features:

[list]
[*] Simulate multiple games at once. You can now simulate through multiple weeks with one button click. Go through one month, two months, three months, or an entire season.
[*] Improved logic for handling coach retirement. Coaches will retire due to a variety of circumstances, based on personality, work history, success, age, and more.
[*] Improved process for saving games. We implemented a new way to handle saving games, which prevents a save from being corrupted if any issues arise while saving.
[*] Added a team budget. Teams in real-life do not have infinite money, and now that is also the case in Football Legend. Teams only have a certain amount of money to spend on their coaching staff. This idea will expanded in future updates, as we add in more financial features which will use the team budget.
[*] We've added in other, minor bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements. But this post is long enough already!
[/list]

That's it for this edition of the Football Legend game development blog!  Our goal is to create the world's most immersive and realistic football management simulator.  We hope you've enjoyed this glimpse behind the scenes and that you're as excited as we are about the upcoming release in late 2023. Stay tuned for more updates and announcements in the near future!
